# RoxyBrowser Guides

> Independent, step-by-step tutorials for RoxyBrowser and antidetect browsing in 2026: installation, fingerprint isolation, proxies, Windows and iPhone device profiles, and multi-account workflows. RoxyBrowser's free plan includes 5 permanent profiles; code 0328SAQA gives 30% off paid plans.

- [How to Use an Antidetect Browser (Step 3)](https://alexmorganxx.github.io/roxybrowser-guide/how-to-use-antidetect-browser/): The repeatable profile-building workflow.
